events.title: Patch Note Demo 1.2.8
events.summary: Major ChangesNew Difficulty Settings: Choose between three difficulty levels to match your preferred playstylePatient Arrival Order: You can now see the order in which patients arrived, helping you prioritize who to treat first. The patient with the number in red has been waiting the longest.Medical ChangesInfluenza replaces UTI: Urinary Tract Infection has been replaced with Influenza.Pneumonia Treatment: Piperacillin/Tazobactam can now also be used to treat Pneumonia.Gameplay ImprovementsQuick

events.title: Demo is out now!
events.summary: The Vital Decisions demo is out now! We are very excited to release the demo today! The demo contains a slice of the full game, playable solo and with up to 8 players. Help us make the game better by filling out the demo form after playing, it helps us a lot! A special thank you to all the playtesters for the support and help in making the demo stable. We hope you're as excited as we are to play the game. -The Hazard Wizard dev team

events.title: Trailer released!
events.summary: We're happy to share our brand new trailer! Check it out on our steam page, let us know what you think. We are working hard on the game, and we appreciate all of your support! We're a small team of 3 passionate devs, and we can't wait for you to play the game very soon. You can request playtest access now, you should have acess to it in a few days when playtests open. A playtest is an unfinished version of the game you can play for free, used to find bugs and get general feedback before the game
